title: SplitBill
creator: Sandixhunter / Sandi Priatna
summary: MIT-licensed group-expense template and walletless browser simulation. Members pay equal shares; the organizer can claim only when all required shares are paid, while contributors can request refunds after an incomplete bill reaches its deadline. November 20, 2026: the creator explicitly states that the template is not published to a network and the Live tab is a placeholder. The README pins tari_template_lib 0.40; its 15 engine-test results are creator-reported. Local personas and simulated balances are separate from a deployed application. Review used the original forum post, full README, MIT license, public page text and available deployment metadata. No third-party code was installed or executed, and no wallet or transaction was operated. The recording is a continuous README walkthrough with page scripts and downloads disabled.
cardSummary: Model equal group expenses, exact share payments and deadline refunds through a walletless simulation and Rust template source.
